---
## publications.yml is generated from papers.bib by bib_to_yml.py (runs automatically before each render)
## needs pub-listing.ejs and pub-listing.css in the same folder
title: "Publications"
description-meta: "Information, PDFs, and social metrics of papers"
title-block-banner: false
listing:
  # Section values come from each bib entry's keywords via KEYWORD_SECTIONS in bib_to_yml.py
  - id: peer-reviewed
    contents: publications.yml
    type: custom
    page-size: 100
    sort: "date desc"
    template: pub-listing.ejs
    include:
      section: "Peer-reviewed"
  - id: preprints
    contents: publications.yml
    type: custom
    page-size: 100
    sort: "date desc"
    template: pub-listing.ejs
    include:
      section: "Preprint"
  - id: techreport
    contents: publications.yml
    type: custom
    page-size: 100
    sort: "date desc"
    template: pub-listing.ejs
    include:
      section: "Technical reports"
css: pub-listing.css
filters: [../remove-stray-divfence.lua]  # This filter is used to remove stray ":::" strings that leak into the HTML output when Quarto's listing wrapper fenced divs are interrupted by raw HTML blocks from the EJS template.
---
